title: Installed Apps note says uninstall keeps the app registered until restart, but DELETE install-local now unregisters it live (installedAdditiveNote is stale)
body:
Blocked-by: #12675

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Reach: the console Installed Apps page, read live. The note tells administrators something the runtime no longer does.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui marketplace/console lane seat owning `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` and the `installedAdditiveNote` i18n strings.

## What

The Installed Apps page shows `installedAdditiveNote`: "uninstall removes the on-disk manifest so the package won't load on next boot, but the running kernel keeps the app registered until you restart the runtime." On objectstack `main` this is no longer true. `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/ID` removes the app from the running server at once.

## Reproduction

1. objectstack `main` `94114c1f`, with the vendored console at pin `daeb77fc`.
2. Boot the showcase from a scratch copy of the app; install-local writes under the server's cwd.
3. As admin, install the CRM package via install-local, then uninstall it from Installed Apps.
4. Expected: the note matches the behaviour.
5. Actual: `GET /api/v1/meta/app` no longer lists the CRM app right after the DELETE, with no restart. The note still says it stays registered until restart.

## Mechanism

- The string lives in `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` ~L4115, plus de, es and other locales. It is rendered by `InstalledListWidget.tsx`.
- The string is unchanged on objectui `main` `a5bb7ac2`.
- Fix: reword the note to the current live-unregister behaviour, or drop it.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `installed apps uninstall note restart still registered installedAdditiveNote` → 1 hit, #12300 (closed; Setup › Apps delete/disable success reporting), which is unrelated.
